title: Local SEO
seo: Local SEO and business profile setup
meta: Your Google Business Profile and local listings set up and matched, so nearby shoppers can find you. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
overview: If you have a shop, studio, pickup point or serve a local area, we set up how nearby people find you. We create or claim your Google Business Profile, fill in hours, categories, services and photos, and make sure your name, address and phone number match across the main listing sites. We add local details to your own site, such as an area page and a map. You stay the owner of every profile we touch.

faq: Does local SEO apply to online-only stores?
Mostly to businesses with a physical place or a service area. If you sell only online, a different service may suit you better, and we tell you that honestly.
Google decides that, often by postcard, video or phone. We prepare everything for the check and guide you through it, but verification is Google's step and not ours.
We cannot create reviews. We make it simple for real customers to leave one, with a short link and polite message wording, within the rules of the platforms.
Do I keep control of the listings?
Yes. Everything is created under your own accounts and email. We ask for access as a manager, never for your password.
